spec.description: Flat 70x40x20 plate with R5 corners, central O12 thru and two O6 thru holes on the midline, 1x45 deg chamfer on all top outer edges. Assumed: the 20 dimension in TOP puts all three holes on the mid-depth (depth/2); the central bore is centred in X (length/2); the two O6 holes are symmetric about the centre with 46 pitch.
spec.name: drilled_plate

chamfer_size.description: 45 deg chamfer size on all top edges

corner_r.description: plate corner radius in TOP view

hole_pitch.description: centre-to-centre distance between the two O6 holes
